prompt:
From the attached casual photo, produce a professional studio headshot of the same person.

Identity is locked: same face, hair, skin tone, eye colour, eyebrows, smile and ears. Do not slim, smooth or age them.

Change: crop to head-and-shoulders with the eyes on the upper third; replace the outfit with a plain navy crew-neck knit; replace the background with a soft mid-grey seamless with a gentle vignette; light with a large soft key from the front-left, subtle fill and a faint hair light so the hair separates from the background. Slight shallow depth of field, 85mm look, natural colour.

Straight-on pose, relaxed shoulders, direct eye contact. No text, no logo.
